name: Topaz
overview: The Bible presents topaz as a precious and highly valued stone, notable for its beauty and rarity, as seen in Job 28:19 where the topaz of Ethiopia is esteemed beyond pure gold. It is prominently featured among the stones set in the high priest's breastplate, symbolizing divine craftsmanship and holiness (Exodus 28:17; 39:10). Additionally, Ezekiel 28:13 highlights topaz as part of the precious stones adorning Eden, signifying its association with God's original perfect creation, while Revelation 21:20 lists topaz among the foundation stones of the New Jerusalem, pointing to its enduring significance in God's redemptive plan.
